Severe generalised tightness: 'the tightest hips of anyone they've seen that day', similar lower back, cannot touch his toes, wakes stiff, poor posture. SCHEDULED SURGERY: laser eye surgery the day after this call, with a doctor's instruction of no screens for two days. Reports losing 30 lb in one month on a self-directed diet in the past year.

outcome.next_step: Second call with the rep Monday July 27, 2:00pm Eastern to take full payment and complete the agreement, after which the Trevor onboarding call would be scheduled. Prospect has laser eye surgery the day after this call and no screens for two days.

notable.note: The cleanest ICP match in the batch and, on the prospect's own account, effectively pre-sold — he had followed the coach for over a year, arrived with written notes, said the price was fine and that he pays his trainer similarly, and named the plan he would take. It did not close because the rep would not send a payment link, insisting on a second call as procedure, after the prospect twice asked to pay online. The same refusal appears in the Pukar Patel call the same day. Two other things worth surfacing: the prospect disclosed laser eye surgery scheduled for the following day and nobody asked whether a surgeon had cleared him for training that he wanted to start the next week; and the rep described the guarantee as 'you will reach your goals' before defining it as adding 8kg to kettlebell working weight, which is not the muscle-gain and mobility outcome the prospect had just spent twenty minutes describing.
